capture.note: Every `reference` verdict below was captured live from that image on that route and window. An accepting reference response carries no pinned body: the 200 envelope is `{"series":[],"metrics":{"completedJobs":N,"totalJobs":N}}` and the job counts are not a property of the query. Every rejecting body IS pinned, on both sides.

limits.what_this_cannot_see: A refusal turned into MATCH-ALL keeps its `accept` disposition and passes this suite unchanged. That is exactly the break that motivated issue #458 and nothing here can catch it — `traces_metrics_nested_set_live.rs` (AC 3b) and the golden SQL in `traces_metrics_sql.rs` (AC 5) are the criteria that can.
